description: What an investment manager (a hedge fund, Berkshire Hathaway, any manager with $100M+ in US stocks) held at the end of its latest quarter, from its 13F filing: top positions by value with share of portfolio, total value, and what changed since the quarter before (new positions, added, trimmed, sold out). Look a fund up by its manager's legal name ('Pershing Square Capital', 'Berkshire Hathaway', 'Scion Asset Management') or SEC CIK. 13F data is quarterly, filed up to 45 days after the quarter ends, and shows long US positions only.
name: fund_holdings
title: Fund holdings (SEC 13F)
